description: Check whether a React recording is running, saved, lost, or taken over. Use after an interruption to decide whether to collect the recording or start again. If the runtime is unavailable, session_status is no_react_runtime and note gives the reason.

device_id.description: Device ID of the app to inspect. During a recording, use the ID passed to react-profiler-start.

port.description: Metro port. Omit it to use this device's port (8081 by default). Ignored for Chromium, whose CDP port is in device_id. Range: 1 to 65535.

name: react-profiler-status
